t: This is the London Fo Guang Shan Temple, at 84 Margaret Street, a Buddhist temple established here in 1992. It is one of two British branches of the Fo Guang Shan Order, which is based in Taiwan, and it is also known as the International Buddhist Progress Society. The building was designed by William Butterfield, a Gothic Revival architect linked to the Oxford Movement and noted for his use of polychromy, the decorative use of many colours in brick and stone.
